items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: So I worked with Papa Mutt for quite a little while

ctx.x: But because I was from Louisiana, he gave me the job. But the footnote to that -- he was right. I could [cure leather] for him! (PHONETIC)

So I worked with Papa Mutt for quite a little while, and then Buck Clayton -- Buck Clayton had a band; let's see ... Les Hyatt had a band at the Cotton Club, okay, and I'm coming up about 5 or 6 years later ...
Can I take you back to Papa Mutt?
